parties.respondent: STATE OF U.P. THR. PRINCIPAL SECRETARY (HOME) & ORS.

summary: Seniority determination for Assistant Radio Officers; 50% quota for direct recruitment versus promotion from Radio Inspectors; invalid combined selection list removing superannuated/deceased officers; Rule 22 seniority mandates original appointment order date; High Court's reliance on Rule 17 reversed; direct recruits' inter-se seniority differs from promotees; Rule 5(1) quota compliance required; appeal upholds seniority fixation based on appointment order date.
legal_provisions_cited: Uttar Pradesh Police Radio Service Rules, 1979 Rule 5(1)
Uttar Pradesh Police Radio Service Rules, 1979 Rule 14
Uttar Pradesh Police Radio Service Rules, 1979 Rule 15
Uttar Pradesh Police Radio Service Rules, 1979 Rule 17
Uttar Pradesh Police Radio Service Rules, 1979 Rule 22
Government Branch Press Vs. D.B. Belliappa (1979) 1 SCC 477
final_judgment: High Court judgment setting aside combined selection list upheld; seniority list quashed for excluding superannuated/deceased officers; appointments reinstated per original appointment order dates; Rule 17 compliance mandatory before appointment issuance.
